title: Job Portal
tagline: A full-stack job portal that connects recruiters and job seekers through a secure, responsive, and user-friendly recruitment platform.
about: The Job Portal & Recruitment System is a full-stack web application developed using HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Python, Django, and MongoDB. The platform enables recruiters to post and manage job listings while allowing job seekers to search for opportunities, submit applications, and manage their profiles. It features secure user authentication, responsive design, and efficient database management, providing a streamlined recruitment experience for both employers and candidates.

challenges.title: Job Search & Filtering
challenges.desc: Implementing fast job search with multiple filters such as location, skills, salary, and job type required efficient query handling and database indexing.

challenges.title: Resume & Application Management
challenges.desc: Managing resume uploads and tracking applications across different stages required secure file handling and a reliable application status workflow.

challenges.title: Role-Based Access
challenges.desc: Supporting separate recruiter and job-seeker features required role-based authentication and authorization to protect job posting and application data.

title: Weather App
tagline: A modern full-stack weather application that provides real-time weather updates, hourly forecasts, 10-day forecasts, favorites, and recent search history through an intuitive dashboard.
about: The Weather Forecast Web App is a full-stack application that provides accurate and real-time weather information for cities worldwide. Users can search any city to view current weather conditions, hourly forecasts, and a 10-day weather forecast. The application includes secure authentication, favorite locations, recent search history, interactive weather charts, and a responsive dashboard. Built with React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and the OpenWeatherMap API, the project focuses on delivering a fast, user-friendly, and visually appealing weather experience across all devices.
features: Real-time Weather Data Integration via OpenWeatherMap API

challenges.title: Real-time Weather Data
challenges.desc: Fetching and displaying accurate real-time weather conditions from the OpenWeatherMap API required handling asynchronous API requests, loading states, and API errors gracefully.

challenges.title: Location-based Forecasts
challenges.desc: Providing weather information based on the user's current location required integrating the browser Geolocation API with weather services while handling permission and location errors.

challenges.title: Dynamic Weather UI
challenges.desc: Creating a responsive interface that dynamically changes weather conditions, icons, and backgrounds based on live forecast data required state-driven rendering and conditional UI logic.

title: BrewHouse Cafe
tagline: A modern full-stack cafe web application featuring secure authentication, online ordering, an admin dashboard, and a responsive user experience.
about: BrewHouse Cafe is a full-stack cafe web application designed to provide a seamless online dining experience. Customers can browse food and beverage menus, create accounts, securely log in, place orders, and manage their profiles. The application also includes an Admin Dashboard that enables administrators to manage menu items, categories, customer orders, and user accounts efficiently. Built with React and Firebase, the platform delivers a responsive, secure, and intuitive experience across desktop and mobile devices.

challenges.title: Responsive Menu Design
challenges.desc: Creating a responsive menu layout that remains easy to browse across mobile, tablet, and desktop screens required flexible grid layouts and adaptive UI components.

challenges.title: Online Ordering Flow
challenges.desc: Designing a smooth ordering experience from menu selection to cart management required maintaining consistent item state and handling quantity updates without disrupting the user experience.

challenges.title: Performance & Visuals
challenges.desc: Balancing high-quality food imagery and attractive animations with fast page loading required image optimization, lazy loading, and careful management of frontend assets.
